_comment: Balance simulator config. Game numbers are NEVER here: they come from data/game_numbers.json. Everything below is a run setting, a labelled assumption, a player-skill profile, a case definition, an override on top of game numbers, or a target band.

run._comment: lanesPerCase = independent parties per case; nDives = consecutive dives per lane (weapon growth carries over, HP resets); seed = RNG seed; device = cuda|cpu|auto; dt = tick seconds; frameRate = frames/s the game's frame counts are expressed in (ASSUMED 60, number map says 60 fps); maxEnemies = enemy slots per room.

assumptions._comment: Model assumptions NOT taken from game_numbers.json. All ASSUMED. Run 5 additions: breadLadder* (PHASE1 bread ladder: free poor loaves before the baker, his bread after; 0 free loaves + bakeryBuilt false = the game as built on 2026-11-15); bakeryAfterFloor = a lane's bakery counts as built from the dive after it first clears this floor (0 = off, use bakeryBuilt); dodgeWindupRefSeconds = dodge chance rises with the wind-up: P = 1-(1-dodgeRate)^max(1, windupSeconds/ref) (0 = off); useFloorStatsKindShare = sample enemy kinds from floorStats.kindShare (the real generator) instead of floorMix.

weaponCycles._comment: Attack kinds per swing cycle per weapon (from heroAttacks). ASSUMED: normal1, normal2, finisher; add "charge" to a list to include charge swings.

skillProfiles._comment: ASSUMED player skill. hitRate = fraction of swings that connect; uptime = fraction of time spent attacking (rest = moving/repositioning, stretches each swing by 1/uptime); dodgeRate = P(an incoming attack is fully dodged); guardRate = P(guard x guardMult when not dodged; guard-break attacks ignore it); reviveWillingness = P a downed hero gets revived when a mate is up; loafThresholdHpFrac = eat a loaf below this HP fraction.

partySkillMix._comment: Weights used when a case lists the profile name "mix".

cases._comment: name, players (1..4), profiles = list per hero slot (repeated if shorter; "mix" samples partySkillMix per lane), loadouts = weapon per hero slot (axe|staff|dagger_shield|bow_sword).
cases.name: p1_average

overrides._comment: Applied on top of game_numbers.json before simulating. Key = dotted path into game_numbers.json (list elements by index: coop.lifeMult.2). Value = number/bool/string (absolute) or {"mult": x} or {"add": x}. Unknown paths raise an error. Examples (kept empty by default): "enemies.Slime.hp": {"mult": 1.2}, "heroAttacks.axe_1.mult": 1.1, "weapons.axe.atk": 24, "growth.levelCostBase": 30, "coop.lifeMult.3": 2.0, "enemyAttacks.rat_lunge.mult": 0.9, "tierScale.tier1Atk": 0.6, "healing.healPointChancePercent": 70.

targets._comment: Run 5 targets (Fable, 2026-11-15), see Reference/sessions/run5-balance/STATUS.md. Bands are [min, max]. Dive keys are dive numbers (1-based).
